description.purpose: A clock a manifest can name, as one `timer` cell: an interval and a schedule key, both parameters, and nothing else. It exists because nine shipped templates carried a timer INSIDE them and none of them was instantiable on its own, so no manifest could give a running colony a periodic tick (GH #484). It sends, it decides nothing: what a tick MEANS is the lane the parent's edge stamps on it.
description.use_when: Whenever something has to happen on the minute rather than at the next touch. Instantiate it under a name that says what it drives -- `sweeper`, `nightly`, `heartbeat` -- and draw ONE edge out of it in the SAME mutation: the tick has no destination of its own, and a tick nobody wired dead-letters as no_route naming the clock itself. The cadence is `override_params` on the node per instance -- a FLAT params object here, because a single-cell template has no inner cell to address -- the `CLOCK_CRON` knob colony-wide, and an `op` message at runtime.
description.not_in_scope: No condition, no filter, no store, no body: a clock that knew what it was ticking for would be a second scheduler. No catch-up either -- a missed firing is dropped, because the next tick asks the same question. And no lane of its own: naming the lane is the parent edge's job, which is what lets one clock drive a sweep here and a trim there.
examples: PORTS - Entry: none. A clock is a producer; the only messages it consumes are schedule ops (add/modify/remove/trigger by schedule_id). Exit: one emission per firing, carrying `event_id`, `schedule_id`, `schedule_name`, `scheduled_at`, `fired_at` and `iteration_n` on the hop, and an empty `messages[]`.

a firewall's expiry receipts, punctual: { "add_nodes": [{"name": "sweeper", "template": "clock", "override_params": {"schedules": [{"schedule_id": "0190a3f2-0000-7000-8000-000000000484", "schedule_name": "tick", "cron": "0 */5 * * * *", "emit_to": ".", "emit_body": {"messages": []}}]}}], "add_edges": [{"from": "./sweeper", "to": "./firewall", "condition": "has(hop.schedule_name) && hop.schedule_name == 'tick'", "modifier": {"set_hop": {"route": "'in_sweep'"}}}] }
one clock, two meanings: a second edge off the same cell onto another hive stamps another lane -- the tick is identical, the lane is not
